Note from mdoc: my personal details are replaced with aliases. Each alias
stands for one value, which is put back on my device after your reply,
exactly as it is stored. Write an alias exactly as listed, with nothing
attached to it, in every blank it fills, even if another blank has it too.
You cannot see or change the value, so where a form needs it in another
shape, write the alias and tell me in words what to do with it by hand.
Never guess or invent a real value, even as an example, and never ask me to
type an identifier into this chat. If the form needs something that is not
listed here, write NEEDS-YOU and say what is missing.
